cache_dir.description: Path to the directory where compiled binaries are stored.

template_dir.description: Path to the directory containing custom script templates for `scriptisto-new`.

languages.description: List of language configurations supported by Scriptisto. Items must be defined in the `items` schema.

languages.items.description: Schema for a single language item within the `languages` list. Defines compiler paths, args, and extensions.

languages.items.name.description: Name of the programming language (e.g., python3, rust, go).

languages.items.compiler_path.description: Path to the compiler or interpreter executable.

languages.items.compiler_args.description: Arguments to pass to the compiler during the build phase.

languages.items.exec_args.description: Arguments to pass to the executable during the run phase.

languages.items.extensions.description: File extension(s) associated with this language.

languages.items.description.description: Optional description of this language configuration.
